//.null_program_correction: REBUILT 2026-09-06 by the null-program correction, which is a MEASUREMENT change and not an engine change: every field in this file moved, and no engine, library or Python-seat source did. The subtrahend was the boot fixture tests/fixtures/parity_boot.pl, a second process that reached neither engine's per-run setup and, having a different command line, did not measure the same fixed cost either: 4,594,811 instructions BELOW upstream's real one and 8,661,096 ABOVE ours, a 13,255,907 bias in this tree's favour on every row, against a corpus whose smallest row is 225,455. It is now the EMPTY PROGRAM through the same driver at the same path length and directory count, median of three processes and of seven when the three disagree, after one process that is run and discarded; a program of no content nets between -13,405 and +12,852 here and between -7,446 and -705 on upstream's across nine corpus shapes, which is this method's resolution. The recorded our_inferences move on 135 of the 148 rows measured in both files, 84 of them DOWNWARD, and not one exceeds the old pin's 2% + 200, so this is the stale half of the 0.8.0 re-pin being brought to this tip rather than any drift: that re-pin advanced thirteen inference fields and left the rest at their 2026-08-31 values.
